title: Ivo and the Summit
author: Ines Montrose
blurb: Rosalind Fairweather, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
